text.guided: A vector is written (x, y): the first number is how far right, the second how far up. Your answer has the two numbers the wrong way round. Before you place a point, say it out loud: "x is …, y is …".
text.fast: Coordinates are ordered pairs: (x, y), not (y, x).

scene.caption: Swap x and y and the point is mirrored across the diagonal
